mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month moving average consistently reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5% in a month), or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a threshold signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y), or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a regime signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,300,000 units in a month, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1300.0), or the Rank IC for HOUST as a threshold signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a severe labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth rate < 1.5% annualized), consumer and business spending weakens, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (GDPC1 growth < 1.5%), or the Rank IC for GDPC1 as a regime signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
